note: Six mandatory edge-case scenarios. Each fixture defines an input set that must produce a deterministic output; expected outcome documented. These are reference fixtures (specification assets), not an implementation. Added FIX-07 governance-failure fixture (architecture review recommendation 2).

scenarios.name: Negative Earnings
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Deterministic output; profitability pillar low; recommendation must not exceed Watch

scenarios.name: Rapid GNPA Deterioration
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Override rule severe-asset-quality caps recommendation at Watch despite otherwise sound metrics

scenarios.name: Capital Adequacy Breach
scenarios.expectedOutcome: CAR below regulatory minimum triggers capital-breach penalty; Strong Buy blocked; recommendation capped at Watch

scenarios.name: Missing Data
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Deterministic output with reduced confidence; missing inputs flagged in evidence; confidence adjusted down, raw metrics unchanged

scenarios.name: Conflicting Indicators
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Strong profitability vs weak asset quality; metric consistency reduced; confidence adjusted; recommendation moderated

scenarios.name: Exceptional Treasury Gains
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Treasury gains flagged; earnings quality assessed; recommendation tempered to account for non-recurring income

scenarios.name: Governance Failure
scenarios.requirement: IES-006 D08 §6 / D09 §6 — severe governance failure override
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Override rule governance-failure caps recommendation at Avoid despite otherwise strong metrics
